name: jointl-ai-plugin
description: Run People Intelligence — launch Flows, evaluate and match people, request references, run verifications, review evidence and insights, and take action.

interface.longDescription: Connect to a Jointl workspace with live role and company permissions. Search authorized people and Flows, review factual Check, employee, and Insights evidence, design complete Flow drafts, run Autopilots, and prepare supported lifecycle or bulk operations with explicit previews and confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Design and create a complete Jointl Flow for this role.
Run the relevant checks for these people.
Identify the top 3 people and provide a deep, evidence-backed comparison.
